name: PUR_NEW_DISCOVERY_TO_EXPERIMENT_AGENT_V3
purpose: Scientific decision Agent that first extracts material-response regularities from measured PUR rheology, translates those regularities into design rules, then selects an informative formulation-process experiment using local evidence, external priors and uncertainty-aware tools.

stages.role: identify the physical failure mode and the relevant rheological regularities before any candidate ranking
execute planner-requested read-only scientific actions; the state-aware rheology tool exposes the paper's upstream physical/model findings without validation outcomes
translate discovered state-shift, thermal-response and temporal-stability patterns into experiment-selection rules
profile chemically admissible candidates and provide transparent support/risk diagnostics without pretending to predict unmeasured viscosity
select the experiment point that best tests the discovered physical problem and evidence-supported formulation hypothesis
check whether the proposed point really follows from the scientific findings, remains interpretable, and avoids leakage or unsupported mechanism claims
freeze one useful experiment point, an uncertainty probe, or abstain when no scientifically interpretable test is available

required_scientific_sequence: state the positive material regularities and their boundaries
translate those regularities into a design objective
use external evidence to identify chemically plausible intervention directions
freeze the selected formulation-process point and falsifiable measurement criterion
architecture_principles: physical discovery comes before candidate ranking
the Agent should use the paper's measured regularities as decision tools rather than rediscovering them from prose each run
state-aware rheology, external chemistry evidence and process uncertainty serve different scientific roles and must remain separated
candidate selection should maximize scientific usefulness for the observed failure mode, not benchmark score
deterministic calculations are separated from language-model judgment
the skeptic is a quality-control step for scientific usefulness, not a component whose removal must be benchmarked
result data are structurally removed before blind replay payloads are assembled
only concise auditable rationales and tool outputs are stored; hidden chain-of-thought is not required
primary_agent_outputs: material regularities used in the decision
design implication derived from each regularity
measurement plan tied to the discovered failure mode
evaluation_priority: scientific usefulness of the selected experiment
traceable use of measured local regularities
reproducibility of the recommendation under the same evidence contract
non_goals: proving that every internal Agent module is individually necessary through ablation
optimizing benchmark recovery as the main scientific objective
claiming that literature-prior proximity predicts the wet-lab outcome
replacing the material-science result with an LLM architecture comparison
claim_boundary: V3.2 is the current discovery-to-experiment implementation. It operationalizes the physical/model findings and improves scientific decision support, but it must not be described as the exact historical code that generated the earlier validation formulation unless matching archived runtime provenance is recovered.
